evidence.themes: The desktop header exposes 雾夜, 纸页, and 琥珀. All visual colors use semantic tokens so canvas, surface, input, selection, warning, success, and focus colors change together.
evidence.persistence: Browser interaction selected each theme, confirmed html[data-theme] and dzmm-next-theme localStorage values, then reloaded and confirmed the selected theme restored.
evidence.responsive: At 390x844 each of the three themes had document scrollWidth <= viewport width. Full-page 1600x900 visual inspection covered 雾夜, 纸页, and 琥珀 creation views.
evidence.verification: npm run build passed; cargo fmt --check and cargo check passed.

boundary: This is source-browser visual evidence only. It does not prove the packaged Tauri WebView, Android UI, or a maturity-score increase.
